responsibility: Declares filename-construction utilities used by gm2 to derive source or output names from module names and extensions. The interface covers full filename construction with extension limits, stem extraction, extension stripping, and module-name extraction from a path, separating naming policy from search-path and option parsing code.
same_name_distinction: This definition module publishes the filename utility API—construction, stem calculation, extension stripping, and module extraction—without committing callers to implementation details. The paired `M2FileName.mod` implements those operations with concrete path separator and length-limit logic.
